notes.problem: Mottled terrain in fog, the hull an invisible speck, a pale strip at the foot
notes.fix: Drop the camera to about 450 m so the channel, bank and hull read in the lower third

notes.problem: An aerial diagram in fog with no hero at legible size and a banded foreground strip
notes.fix: Lower to an oblique about 300 m up from over the channel with the hull moored large at the near bank

notes.problem: A speckle plain under a hard horizon with the square floating on it and the hull an invisible speck
notes.fix: Drop the camera to a 150 m oblique from over the channel so the bank, water and hull own the lower third and the square recedes behind them

notes.problem: A flat black water band over a pale strip, the planned riprap slope absent
notes.fix: Move the camera inland and lower its pitch so the bank and quay line fill the lower third and water takes no more than a fifth

notes.problem: A flat near-black water slab in the lower part, the hero a speck, the positions a CAD overlay in fog
notes.fix: Drop the camera to about 60 m over the channel edge looking along the quay with the hull berthed at 15% of the width, and crop the water to a fifth of the height

notes.problem: A flat near-black water slab over a beige band, untextured white boxes, more buildings than the release's 8 to 10
notes.fix: Lower and pitch the camera so the bank, quay line and a moored hull sit in the lower third, and draw at most 10 production buildings with roof and wall detail

notes.problem: A clipped hatted figure, a warped flag, no visible window
notes.fix: Delete the clipped figure, seat residents mid-room from behind, and light the room from the planned window

notes.problem: A cylinder flag, a hat brim through a ponytail, a head cropped at the edge, no readable window
notes.fix: Remove the flag, swap the hatted figure for a hatless one, delete the cropped head, and throw a sun patch across the dais front

notes.problem: A ponytail clipping a hat brim, a rolled-cylinder flag, a blank seal and mostly empty rows
notes.fix: Swap the foreground figure for a hatless resident and seat 6 to 8 more residents across the rows

notes.problem: The deckhouse rises behind the dek
notes.fix: Lower and shift the camera so the sheer sits below the dek

notes.problem: The deckhouse rises behind the dek
notes.fix: Pan the camera about 6 degrees right or drop the hull so the deckhouse sits below the dek's last line

notes.problem: The hull is cropped behind the dek and the lower half is empty gravel
notes.fix: Pull the camera back and lower the horizon so the whole hull sits below the dek and the block line and person fill the lower third

notes.problem: The deckhouse close-up reads as a stone lighthouse with no scale cue
notes.fix: Remodel the deckhouse with sensor housings, a radar array and stanchions, and put a person on the riprap for scale

notes.problem: At close range the deckhouse reads as a monument, with little sun and shade separation
notes.fix: Model sensor arms, radome, whips and stanchions and rotate the sun so the near faces are 20 L* apart

notes.problem: Flat overhead light, the radome touching the dek, streaked water
notes.fix: Rake the key light and lower the hull about 30 px so the mast clears the dek

notes.problem: The mast's sensor ball touches the dek's last line and the hull reads as a primitive
notes.fix: Lower the hull or raise the camera so the mast top clears the dek baseline by 40 px
